title: Gooey Cheese Keto Toast
description: A simple, rich keto snack made with gooey cheese and crispy toast.
instructions: 2. Place the slices of toast on a baking sheet.
3. Bake the toast in the oven for 2-3 minutes, or until lightly toasted.
4. Remove the toast from the oven and top each slice with a slice of cheese.
5. Return the toast to the oven and bake for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and gooey.
6. Remove the toast from the oven and serve immediately.
